## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in San Jose, United States. It starts at 870 Great Mall Drive.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Brick by colorful brick, LEGOLAND® Discovery Center is the ultimate indoor LEGO® playground, located inside the Great Mall in Milpitas, California.
>
> Inspire young imaginations with over 2 million LEGO bricks in one location. The indoor LEGO adventure is a 2-3 hour play experience with a LEGO themed ride, a 4D cinema featuring all of your favorite LEGO characters, and MINILAND™ – a LEGO recreation of the Bay Area’s most popular landmarks.
>
> Kids can get tips and tricks from the Master Model Builder in the Creative Workshop, as well as design their own LEGO car and test it out in LEGO Racers: Build & Test. They can also imagine their very own LEGO world in LEGO Friends: Heartlake City and more!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €25.05. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 26 ratings and 17 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
